cast.name: Tex Lexington
cast.who: a Black Ethiopian-Texan man in his thirties
cast.wears: tan felt cowboy hat, white cotton shamma with a red tibeb border, brown shirt, denim

cast.name: settlers
cast.wears: white cotton shamma, some with tibeb borders; head wraps, a turban, braids

pairs.title: Main street
pairs.note: Genie: Tex from behind on a grey horse, saloon fronts and tukuls, stelae, glass domes, the storm on the horizon. Game: the same blocking, rebuilt, with Tex on make-photo's grey donkey and the camera locked at the same height.

pairs.title: Settlers on the street
pairs.note: Genie drifted the settlers into Texas cowhands in brown dusters. The game holds them: Black Ethiopian men and women in white cotton shamma, two leading pack donkeys with 20 L cans.

pairs.title: The storm
pairs.note: In Genie the storm never left the horizon. In the game it comes up the street, and the mesas go first.

pairs.title: Inside the storm
pairs.note: The beat Genie could not play: red dust fills everything and only Tex's white shamma shows. The change happens here, where no one can see it.

pairs.title: The future behind the town
pairs.note: Genie raised carved towers, wind turbines, a train line and water drones behind the frontier. The game keeps all four, and its towers stand on the cross plan of the rock churches.
